data.one_liner: A client for the Chrome DevTools Protocol to talk to debuggers.
data.what_it_does: The package acts as a client for the Chrome DevTools Protocol (previously Webkit Inspection Protocol). It is used to communicate with and control Chrome DevTools-based debuggers.
use_when: You need to build tooling that talks to Chrome DevTools-based debuggers.
You want to programmatically interact with browser tabs and debugging domains like Runtime or Debugger.
avoid_when: You are building standard application features unrelated to browser debugging.
You need an official Google-supported product.
strengths: Provides direct client support for the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
Supports retry mechanisms and custom error handling for connections.
weaknesses: Documentation outside of the basic protocol reference is minimal.
